name: persade

relevance.justification: Directly aligned with BioThings entity types. 10,235 compounds with InChIKey annotations (→ MyChem.info), 6,980 human proteins with UniProt IDs, 19,991 ADE terms mapped to MeSH/UMLS CUIs, 4,061,772 personalized drug-ADE associations with demographic stratification, 108,677 drug-protein interactions, 31,756 protein-ADE associations. Covers drugs, proteins, and adverse events — three BioThings entity types. Structured relational data with standard identifiers.

novelty.justification: Novel in three ways: (1) Personalized ADEs — 4M+ associations stratified by age, sex, weight, administration route, and disease indication; not in SIDER, AEOLUS, or OFFSIDES. (2) Mechanistic drug-protein-ADE triplets — 194,874 triplets with confidence tiers (Valid/High/Medium) and organ specificity; not in existing BioThings sources. (3) Off-target drug-protein interactions (17,208 with quantitative binding affinity) mapped to ADEs — extends ChEMBL bioactivity data with ADE context. SIDER in MyChem.info covers only label-derived drug-ADE pairs without personalization or mechanistic context.

openness.justification: Paper states 'freely accessible at https://idrblab.org/PersADE' and 'without login requirement'. Download page (persade.idrblab.net/resource.php) is accessible and serves XLSX files publicly. However: (1) Latest available download files are dated 2023-06-27, not matching the 2026 NAR paper's 4M record count (download has ~461K associations); (2) license not explicitly stated. Files are downloadable without login or API key. Assumed CC BY-NC 4.0 from idrblab pattern.

evidence.scope: Personalized drug-adverse event associations with molecular mechanism context. 4,061,772 personalized drug-ADE associations, 31,756 protein-ADE associations, 108,677 drug-protein interactions (17,208 quantitative), 10,235 compounds (InChIKey), 6,980 proteins (UniProt), 19,991 ADE terms (UMLS/MeSH), 194,874 drug-protein-ADE triplets, pharmacogenomic data from PharmGKB. Key demographic stratification: age, sex, weight, administration route, dosage form, disease indication.
evidence.overlap: Partial overlap with SIDER (label-derived drug-ADE) and AEOLUS (FAERS-derived). Novel: personalized stratification, mechanistic triplets, off-target protein mapping, confidence scoring system.

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0 (assumed, consistent with other idrblab databases)
restrictions: Non-commercial use only — BioThings academic deployment compatible

risks: CRITICAL: Download page shows files dated 2023-06-27 with only ~461K drug-ADE pairs (InChIKey+MeSH format), not the 4M personalized associations described in the 2026 NAR paper. The full PersADE dataset appears not yet available for bulk download.
License not explicitly stated — assumed CC BY-NC 4.0
Personalization data (age/sex/route stratification) may only be accessible via web interface, not bulk download
The resource.php page appears to serve the older mtADENet database files, not the new PersADE-specific data
next_actions: Proceed to inspection with available download files — flag data gap between paper and download
